back_story: Vice City is nothing without its radio. FM stations pumped new wave, funk, rock and Latin through every open window — the mixtape era's golden hour. A boombox on a hood, a cassette thrown in the air, neon waves leaking from the speakers: this is the sound of 1986, and the city's real soundtrack.
